name: Gilman Electrical Supply
old_description: Gilman Electrical Supply, a division of Consolidated Electrical Distributors, provides electrical supplies to electricians and contractors for residential, commercial, and industrial applications. We pride ourselves
about:
Gilman Electrical Supply operates as a division of Consolidated Electrical Distributors from its location in Augusta, Maine. The company functions as a wholesale electrical supplier serving the New England region.

The distributor stocks a broad range of electrical supplies from leading manufacturers, covering residential, commercial, and industrial applications. Its service model includes contractor accounts and an online customer portal that enables quote requests, online ordering, and personalized catalog creation for registered users.

Primary customers are electricians and contractors working across residential, commercial, and industrial projects. The company supports these trade professionals with account-based purchasing and digital procurement tools designed for repeat ordering.

Gilman Electrical Supply emphasizes its extensive product line from top manufacturers and long-term customer relationships as core differentiators. The online portal further distinguishes its offering by providing self-service quoting, ordering, and custom catalog management.
